title: Reconcile and prepare exact admission-family performance measurement
summary: Rebind the admission cell space to the reviewed family catalog, add exact performance-only A0-A7 runtime authorization, compile and validate a deterministic dry-run campaign, and stop before host-sensitive measurement.
planned_changes: Add factor-cell-space v3 and schema without rewriting retained v2; add an exact manifest-bound performance-only admission token, option propagation, runtime gate, and focused negative tests; add a versioned eight-cell campaign contract and deterministic dry-run compiler; validate current hashes, exact cells, workload schedule, metric definitions, and environment requirements; keep actual timing execution pending an explicit host and workload decision.
verification_plan: Validate all new canonical JSON against its schema and recompute hashes; prove exactly A0 through A7 compile and all four bounded cells, covering-array intent, outside axes, stale hashes, correctness intent, active intent, and performance-acceptance intent fail closed; run focused runtime authorization tests; build source and tests in Release; validate the four touched SpecTrace artifacts directly; run git diff --check; and record actual measurement as not run pending the selected execution environment and workload scope.
completion_notes: Readiness implementation is complete through factor-space v3, exact runtime authorization, deterministic eight-cell dry-run compilation, focused tests, and a clean analyzer-enabled Release build. Actual performance-runner extension, timing execution, raw evidence, and effect analysis remain pending the explicit host and workload-scope decision.

CI modification, push, or deletion of retained evidence
